title: Fate’s rope, the human cow
odia:
ଦଇବ ଦଉଡି ମଣିଷ ଗାଇ
ଯେଣିକି ଟାଣିବ ସେଣିକି ଯାଇ।
literal_meaning: Fate is the rope, a human the cow; wherever it pulls, that way the cow goes.
meaning_odia: ଦଇବକୁ ଦଉଡ଼ି ଓ ମଣିଷକୁ ସେହି ଦଉଡ଼ିରେ ଚାଲୁଥିବା ଗାଈ ସହ ତୁଳନା କରାଯାଇଛି। ଯେଉଁ ଦିଗକୁ ଟାଣ ଆସେ, ସେହି ଦିଗକୁ ଯିବାର ଚିତ୍ରରେ ବଚନଟି ଭାଗ୍ୟର ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣକୁ ଜୋର ଦେଉଛି। ଏହା ବଚନର ଭାଗ୍ୟନିର୍ଭର ଦୃଷ୍ଟି; ମଣିଷର ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ଓ ଚେଷ୍ଟା ସର୍ବଦା ଅର୍ଥହୀନ ବୋଲି ଆମର ଦାବି ନୁହେଁ।
explanation: The image gives fate the directing force of a rope and the human the place of the cow being led. It expresses a sense that life is pulled along by powers beyond one’s control. That fatalism belongs to the saying; the entry does not treat it as proof that choices or effort have no effect.
usage_example: Original imagined example: An unexpected transfer changes someone’s plans for where to live. Describing the feeling of being carried in an unforeseen direction, they recall fate’s rope and the cow.
cultural_context: The paired directions ଯେଣିକି and ସେଣିକି make the movement follow the pull. The concrete tethering image turns an abstract idea of fate into something felt as direction and constraint.

witnesses.locator: Page23, eighth item beginning ଦଇବ ଦଉଡି.
